comment_regular: Verified cross-build layout divergence: Fallout NonActorMagicTarget has MagicTarget size 16 and total size 40; constructor places parent ref at +0x1C and BSSimpleList header at +0x20. Oblivion MagicTarget is 8 bytes and NonActorMagicTarget is 32 bytes, with parent at +0x14 and ActiveEffectList header at +0x18. Fallout's extra IsInvulnerable vtable slot is absent in Oblivion; do not transfer its later vtable offsets or data offsets.
